description:
The surah that opens by addressing the enwrapped Prophet as the **Shrouded** Messenger. It takes its name from the word "wrapped in mantle" (muddaththir) in verse 1. The first verses of this surah (verse 1 ff.) were revealed after one of the Prophets first encounter with the Angel of Revelation in the Cave of Ḥirāʾ. The surah goes on, in a section from a later period, to remind the obstinate disbelievers of their fate on the Day of Judgement (verse 8 ff.) and a specific opponent of the Prophet is singled out (verse 11 ff.). The end of the surah (verse 39 ff.) exposes the foolishness of the disbelievers" attitude to the Revelation and the Day of Resurrection.
The surah is also known as The Cloaked One, The Enfolded, The Enfolded One, The Enveloped, The Man Wearing a Cloak, The Mantled Messenger, Wrapped in his Cloak

24.2: That is, from the magicians of old. Or 'traditional magic.'

26.1: _Saqar_ is another name for hell or a part of it.

31.1: That is, the statement that there are nineteen wardens in charge of hell.

43.1: Or 'We were not among followers of the _leaders_ (or _forerunners_, mentioned in <{["Q", "56:10"]}>).' (See _Tafsīr al-Qummī_, _Tafsīr Furāt al-Kūfī_, _al-Kāfī_, i, 484, ''Kitāb al-Ḥujjah," bāb 108 (bāb fīhi nukat wa nutaf min al-tanzīl fī al-wilāyah), no. 38.

translations.6: _Do not grant_ a favour seeking a greater gain,
translations.7: and _be patient_ for the sake of your Lord.
translations.8: When the Trumpet will be sounded,
translations.9: that day will be a day of hardship,
translations.10: not at all easy for the faithless.
translations.11: Leave Me [to deal] with him whom I created alone,
translations.12: and then furnished him with extensive means,
translations.13: and [gave him] sons to be at his side,
translations.15: Still he is eager that I should give him more.
translations.16: No indeed! He is an obstinate opponent of Our signs.
translations.17: Soon I will overwhelm him with hardship.
translations.20: Again, perish he, how he decided!
translations.24: saying, 'It<{["F", 1]}> is nothing but magic handed down.<{["F", 2]}>
translations.25: It is nothing but the speech of a human being.'
translations.26: Soon I shall cast him into Saqar.<{["F", 1]}>
translations.27: And what will show _you_ what is Saqar?
translations.31:
We have assigned only angels as keepers of the Fire,
   and We have made their number
    merely a stumbling block for the faithless,
  and that those given the Book may be reassured,
  and the faithful may increase in [their] faith,
  and that those given the Book may not doubt
    and the faithful [as well],
  and that those in whose hearts is a sickness may say,
    and the faithless [along with them],
   'What did Allah mean by this description?'
  Thus does Allah lead astray whomever He wishes,
    and guides whomever He wishes.
  No one knows the hosts of _your_ Lord except Him,
   and it<{["F", 1]}> is just an admonition for all humans.
translations.33: By the night when it recedes!
translations.34: By the dawn when it brightens!
translations.35: Indeed it is one of the greatest [signs]
translations.37:
[alike] for those of you who like to advance ahead
    and those who would linger behind.
translations.38: Every soul is hostage to what it has earned,
translations.39: except the People of the Right Hand.
translations.43:
They will answer,
   'We were not among those who prayed.<{["F", 1]}>
translations.44: Nor did we feed the poor.
translations.45: We used to gossip along with the gossipers,
translations.46: and we used to deny the Day of Retribution,<{["F", 1]}>
translations.48: So the intercession of the intercessors will not avail them.
translations.49:
What is the matter with them
   that they evade the Reminder
translations.50: as if they were terrified asses
translations.52:
Rather everyone of them desires
   to be given unrolled scriptures [from Allah].
translations.53:
No indeed!
  Rather they do not fear the Hereafter.
translations.54:
No indeed!
  It is indeed a reminder.
translations.55: So let anyone who wishes remember it.
translations.56:
And they will not remember unless Allah wishes.
  He is worthy of [your] being wary [of Him]
   and He is worthy to forgive.
